translation: In general, for these two diseases one should take the points of the four vessels, only differentiating their yin and yang. Wang Shuhe said: When one diagnoses the Yang Wei vessel as floating, [the patient] suddenly rises with dizziness; when the yang is exuberant and excess, [he] suffers from shoulder breathing and a chill-like shivering (sasa). When one diagnoses the Yin Wei vessel as deep, large, and excess, [he] suffers from pain in the chest, fullness in the ribs below the flank, and heart pain.
